verdict.rationale: Vercel documents two first-party natural-language surfaces. Vercel Agent is a built-in AI assistant that can investigate issues and take approved actions. The official Vercel MCP server exposes tools with sample prompts, so approved AI clients can deploy, read logs and analytics, and buy domains by prompt. Coverage is partial: Vercel Agent is public beta and limited to Pro/Enterprise teams, and the MCP route requires an approved third-party client. The documented MCP tools also omit many operations, such as env vars, DNS, rollbacks and rollouts. missing for 10: generally available built-in natural-language control across all plans, MCP/agent coverage of the full operational surface (environment variables, DNS records, rollbacks, rollouts), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Vercel Agent is an AI assistant built into Vercel. Use it to understand your projects, investigate production issues, review code, and take approved actions.
Chat in Slack, dashboard chat, Investigations, and Code Review are in public beta for Pro and Enterprise teams.
Connect your AI tools to Vercel using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that lets AI assistants interact with your Vercel projects.
Each tool documents parameters and a sample prompt.
